Seller is offering **$10,000 toward buyer’s closing costs or rate buydown with an acceptable offer!**

Welcome to 3231 Hannover St, a unique tri-level pool home in the desirable Westport community of Corona. This home offers a flexible hillside-inspired layout that is uncommon for the area and provides excellent separation of living spaces, privacy, and multiple areas to gather or retreat.

The front entry opens to the middle level, where you will find a bedroom that works well as a guest room, office, or private sitting area. From this level, stairs lead both upstairs to the main living areas and downstairs to the lower level.

The upper level is the heart of the home and includes the kitchen, dining area, family room, powder bath, and spacious primary suite. This elevated living area allows for more natural light, neighborhood and mountain views, and convenient access to an exterior stairway leading down to the backyard and pool. The kitchen features bright cabinetry, generous counter space, and an open connection to the dining and family room areas.

The lower level offers additional flexibility with a second living room/family room, two bedrooms, a full bathroom, laundry room, direct garage access, and a sliding glass door leading to the backyard. This setup creates strong separation between the primary suite and secondary bedrooms, and works well for guests, extended stays, older children, roommates, or anyone wanting private space on a separate level.

The backyard is a true highlight, featuring a private pool and spa, patio space, and a relaxing Southern California setting. With multiple indoor living areas, a 3-car garage, good condition, and a layout designed for privacy and versatility, this home offers something different from the typical two-story floor plan.

Certified Pre-Owned Home™: The seller has completed pre-listing home and termite inspections, and inspection reports will be provided for buyer review. The seller is also offering a premium 12-month home warranty for added peace of mind.

If you value privacy, flexible living spaces, separation between bedrooms, elevated living areas, a private pool, and the opportunity to use a $10,000 seller credit toward closing costs or a rate buydown, this unique Corona home is worth seeing in person.

results.remarks:
Welcome home to a beautifully built 5-bedroom, 3-bathroom residence offering the perfect blend of modern luxury, incredible energy efficiency, and resort-style community living in Corona.

Step inside to discover an entertainer’s dream layout. The heart of the home is a gourmet kitchen featuring sparkling granite countertops and a massive custom 6-seat center island that flows seamlessly into the main living spaces. You can cozy up by the gas fireplace in the living room or enjoy immersive movie nights with a built-in surround sound system and hidden wiring throughout all living areas for a sleek, wireless look. This floor plan was designed with supreme functionality in mind, boasting a highly sought-after DOWNSTAIRS BEDROOM AND FULL BATHROOM—perfect for guests, multi-generational living, or a private home office. Everyday convenience is further maximized by a large, dedicated laundry room complete with ample built-in storage.

This home is a true powerhouse of energy efficiency and smart upgrades. Enjoy massive savings on your utility bills with the fully PAID OFF SOLAR system, a whole-house fan to keep things cool, and a tankless water heater. Step outside to your own vibrant, farm-to-table backyard retreat. The yard is maintained by a smart irrigation sprinkler system with a built-in rain monitor and features beautiful rose bushes alongside an incredible established garden producing tomatoes, jalapeños, limes, blackberries, grapes, strawberries, bell peppers, mint, and more.

All of this is located in the highly desirable Sycamore Creek community, giving you an unparalleled lifestyle for a remarkably low HOA fee of only $85 per month. Residents enjoy 24/7 community security, a huge resort-style pool, a state-of-the-art fitness center, a welcoming community center, an action-packed bike park, a skate park, dedicated dog parks, and regular community events that make this neighborhood truly feel like home. Homes with this level of self-sustaining upgrades and premium amenities do not last long.

results.remarks: Welcome to your opportunity to own an exceptional home in the highly sought-after gated Terramor community, where breathtaking mountain views, resort-style amenities, and modern energy-efficient living come together to create an unmatched lifestyle. Perfectly situated in one of Corona's premier master-planned communities, this beautifully appointed residence offers the space, upgrades, and location you have been searching for. From the moment you step inside, you'll appreciate the bright, open-concept floor plan designed for both comfortable everyday living and effortless entertaining. The spacious great room flows seamlessly into the gourmet kitchen, creating the ideal gathering space for family and friends. The kitchen is truly the heart of the home, featuring an oversized center island with bar seating, stainless steel appliances, abundant cabinetry, generous counter space, and an impressive walk-in pantry. The thoughtfully designed layout continues upstairs where you'll find a spacious loft offering endless flexibility. The outdoor living space is equally impressive. Step onto the expansive backyard deck and take in the stunning mountain views while enjoying your private spa. Whether you're relaxing after a long day, entertaining guests under the stars, or enjoying your morning coffee while watching the sunrise over the surrounding hills, this backyard offers the perfect setting to enjoy Southern California living year-round. Adding tremendous value and long-term savings are the home's premium upgrades, including a PAID OFF solar system that helps reduce monthly utility costs and a whole-house water softener. Living in Terramor means more than owning a beautiful home—it's embracing an incredible lifestyle. Residents enjoy access to an impressive collection of resort-inspired amenities including a sparkling pool, clubhouse, community events and more. The gated community provides both privacy and peace of mind while offering convenient access to shopping, dining, schools, commuter routes, and everything Corona has to offer. Homes with this combination of spectacular mountain views, premium upgrades, paid-off solar, private spa, spacious floor plan, and location within the prestigious Terramor community are in high demand. Whether you're searching for the perfect place to entertain, relax, or simply enjoy a resort-style lifestyle every day, this exceptional property checks all the boxes.

results.remarks:
Welcome to one of the largest homes in the aptly named Painted Hills community. Ideally situated on a spacious corner lot at the start of a quiet cul-de-sac, this home offers a comfortable layout with 3512 sq ft designed for optimal living. The main level features a formal living room, dining room, and family room, along with a powder room and a versatile den that can easily serve as a fifth bedroom or home office. The kitchen is well-maintained and thoughtfully laid out, complete with granite countertops, a center island, pantry, and ample cabinetry. You’ll also find a dedicated laundry room with washer and dryer included, plus a spacious three-car garage with built-in storage. The low HOA provides access to a neighborhood park, playground, and picnic area.

Upstairs, the oversized primary suite offers a relaxing retreat with a large en-suite bathroom, separate tub, and additional space perfect for a sitting area or workspace. Three additional bedrooms, a full bathroom, a bright secondary living area, and high ceilings complete the upper level.

The backyard is a private, grassy space lined with palm trees, offering plenty of room to add a pool, pergola, or outdoor entertaining area. Enjoy mountain views and a convenient location just minutes from Glen Ivy Hot Springs, the I-15 freeway, and popular destinations like The Shops at Dos Lagos and Tom’s Farms.

With its generous space, flexible layout, and great location, this home is ready for you to make it your own.

results.remarks: A true Mid-Century masterpiece in the heart of Corona! Built in 1963 and offering approximately 2,850 square feet with 4 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, this one-of-a-kind home showcases dramatic architecture, walls of glass, soaring ceilings, and seamless indoor-outdoor living. A wide double-door entry with a large textured-glass window welcomes you inside, filling the foyer with natural light while maintaining privacy. From the moment you enter, your eyes are drawn to the massive great room with its spectacular vaulted wood-beam ceiling and incredible wall of glass. Eight oversized sliding glass doors topped by angular windows span much of the rear of the home, bringing in abundant natural light and beautiful views of the backyard, pool, palms, and mature landscaping. At the center of the room is a show-stopping Mid-Century fireplace with a dramatic suspended chimney descending from the ceiling. The spacious kitchen offers abundant cabinetry, granite countertops, a large center island, stainless steel appliances, and an atrium-style window over the sink. Both bathrooms have been beautifully updated, including a recently remodeled guest bath with shaker cabinetry, a large walk-in shower, and oversized window. The primary bath also features a walk-in shower and long horizontal window above the vanity. Spacious bedrooms offer large windows and ceiling fans. Additional features include a dedicated laundry room and storage room with built-in shelving. Major improvements include a newer roof, HVAC system, ductwork and vents, three-zone climate control, and updated fencing. Outside, the 10,454-square-foot lot is made for Southern California living with a pool and spa, new sod, fresh mulch, and an expansive concrete patio stretching across nearly the entire rear of the home beneath a large wood pergola. An oversized driveway provides abundant parking in addition to the two-car carport. Conveniently located near Corona's Historic District and exciting Downtown revitalization, including The HUB with new dining and businesses, plus the major transformation of historic City Park with planned recreation, gathering, aquatic, and outdoor amenities. Easy freeway access. A rare opportunity to own a distinctive piece of Corona's Mid-Century architectural character!

results.remarks:
Welcome to the guard-gated 55+ community of Terramor in Temescal Valley. Situated at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac on just shy of 11,000 sq. ft. lot, this expansive IronTree II model, the largest of its kind, offers one of the neighborhood's most private and generous homesites. Featuring 2 bedrooms + an office that can be used as a 3rd bedroom (buyer to install closet), 2 upgraded bathrooms, over 1,900 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space, the home blends comfort and function.

The open-concept floor plan features soaring 10-foot ceilings, a striking 10-foot quartz kitchen island, thick quartz countertops, a farmhouse sink, fresh Designer Flat White interior paint, paid solar, an epoxy-coated two-car garage, and an extended driveway with parking for up to six vehicles.

The property is embraced by nature with surrounding hillsides, seasonal winter greenery, wildflowers, hummingbirds by day, and owls at night. Morning sunlight fills the home from the east while northern exposure provides afternoon shade.

The home is positioned with its back facing the ascending hills, offering sweeping skies and sunset views toward the Santa Ana Mountains. Sitting approximately four feet higher and five feet farther back into the lot than neighboring homes, it enjoys natural light, added privacy, and unobstructed views.

The property also includes numerous fire safety and resilience features, including a modern tile fire-retardant roof, an upgraded indoor fire sprinkler system with steel piping, an exterior fire hose spigot, and a fire hydrant located approximately 20 feet from the home. The adjacent emergency access road is designated exclusively for fire department use and serves as a fire access route, creating a quiet dead-end setting with no through traffic. Additional exterior features include brick perimeter walls and Terramor's community water storage system. The current homeowner paid under $1,001.15 annually for homeowners insurance during the last three years.

Residents of Terramor enjoy resort-style amenities including indoor and outdoor pools, a clubhouse with a bar and entertainment lounge, fitness center, spa, sauna, pickleball, tennis and bocce courts, fire pits, craft and game rooms, a community garden, scenic walking trails, dog parks, and additional recreational spaces.

results.remarks:
Welcome to 55+ living in the sought after Terramor community, where resort style amenities meet functional home design. Located in the Cortina neighborhood, this upgraded Corvara model offers comfort and breathtaking natural scenery — all within one of Southern California’s desirable active adult enclaves.  
The entry sets the tone with an elegantly tiled foyer wall and tray ceiling, which continues through the den and owner’s suite. Throughout the home, ceramic tile flooring adds durability, easy maintenance, and a cohesive upscale look, enhancing every room with clean lines and modern appeal. The den/office is framed by custom full length French doors featuring “heavy water” textured glass, creating a bright, stylish, and private flex space that can easily convert into a third bedroom.
The owner’s suite is highlighted by a custom barn door that adds both style and versatility — allowing you privacy between the bedroom and bathroom when desired. The ensuite includes a spacious walk in closet, while the guest bedroom also features its own walk in closet for exceptional storage.
The kitchen blends style and function with satin finished granite countertops, a walk in pantry, upgraded lighting, and soft close cabinet doors and drawers throughout.  The adjacent cantina showcases an upgraded pendant chandelier, adding a stylish focal point to this gathering space. 
Large sliding glass doors from both the family room and the cantina frame the picturesque landscape, allowing you to enjoy the mountain views from inside the home and creating a seamless connection to the outdoors.
Step outside to the breathtaking outdoor living area featuring beautifully landscaped front and rear yards, maintained effortlessly with a fully automated irrigation system. A large concrete patio provides the perfect setting for relaxation and entertaining. Enjoy evenings around a custom natural gas firepit/table, an ideal spot for stargazing or unwinding with friends.
